AI Training for Leaders & Teams | Meet the AI Executive Sandbox

What could you build if you applied AI to a real challenge in your business? I’m Keisha Solomon of EVOBRAND Concepts, and this is the AI Executive Sandbox: practical, hands-on AI learning for leaders, entrepreneurs, and organizational teams. In this introduction, I explain how the program helps participants move from exploring AI to building working assets they can use. THE GUIDED PROGRAM INCLUDES: • Eight 90-minute sessions • Seven working assets • AI readiness, governance, ethics, and privacy • Executive workflows and no-code automation • Brand content resources and rapid prototyping • A capstone project and final showcase • One private remote coaching session per participant No coding required. GET STARTED: Explore the free Starter experience or learn about training for your team: https://evobrandai.com/ What’s one recurring task you’d like to improve with AI? Tell me in the comments. #AIExecutiveSandbox #AIForBusiness #EVOBRAND
